todos.content: Implement 'devwisdom briefing [--days DAYS]' command to get daily briefing. Support JSON output format.

Create zsh/ directory with devwisdom.plugin.zsh main file. Implement helper functions: devwisdom-daily, devwisdom-quote, devwisdom-consult. Add auto-completion support.
Final polish including error message improvements, logging improvements, performance optimization, cross-compilation (Windows, Linux, macOS), and CI/CD setup.
